title: ERC-20 Learning Token — reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong ERC-20 Learning Token solution should meet the objective: Use a pinned OpenZeppelin Contracts dependency to create and test a token with a documented minting authority and supply policy. It should use a repeatable local test setup and explain why the selected rules preserve the intended behavior.
explanation: Review technical correctness, authorization, boundary behavior, repeatability, and limitation statements. Do not treat a passing demo as a comprehensive security assessment.

review_rubric.criterion: Technical correctness and fit to task
